label: Teltonika RUTX08 (EOL)
description: A four-port gigabit VPN router with no cellular modem and no Wi-Fi: 1 WAN (reconfigurable as LAN) + 3 LAN, all gigabit. A wired router for a branch office that already has its uplink.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTX08 datasheet: 1 x WAN port (can be configured as LAN) 10/100/1000 Mbps and 3 x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps, IEEE 802.3/802.3u. No cellular modem and no Wi-Fi: the datasheet contains no 802.11 wireless section, so neither is claimed. End of life per the vendor, kept in the catalogue because these are still in racks.
